content.short: Slingshot DAO is a Web3 gaming society that lets gamers own and create in community-driven games.
content.description: Slingshot DAO connects gamers and developers, giving users the role of creators and owners of a game. The project enables gamers to design unique experiences and bring gaming ideas to life through transparent DAO voting, where proposals are debated and decided by the community. By distributing creative and ownership rights within a decentralized framework, Slingshot DAO supports collaborative development and shared accountability among participants. It also enables community-owned IP, so the system stays sustainable in the long run.
